stories.title: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says
stories.take: The hype check lands hard — despite massive spend, AI has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside tech, an Apollo economist says.

stories.title: Anthropic sued for allegedly using 274 Elvis Presley songs to train AI models
stories.take: Elvis joins the AI training fight — the catalogue owners say Anthropic infringed 274 songs, including “Can’t Help Falling in Love.”

stories.title: Starlink seems to be working normally again in Ukraine
stories.take: Starlink is back to normal in Ukraine after a week of front-line disruption — and Ukraine disputes Musk’s claim its military violated the terms.

stories.title: Scientists Trapped an Antimatter Particle for Months to Study Its Secrets
stories.take: Scientists held an antimatter particle for months — a long trap that lets them probe its secrets far more closely than before.

stories.title: TechCrunch Mobility: Blue-green is the color of autonomy
stories.take: Blue-green is autonomy’s new signal color — TechCrunch Mobility tracks how AI is taking over the future of transportation.

stories.title: The PHP Meltdown Shows How AI Makes Bugs More Exploitable
stories.take: The PHP meltdown is the warning — AI makes old bugs far easier to find and exploit, and the internet runs on that code.

stories.title: US military gives Elon Musk’s SpaceX access to sensitive tracking data
stories.take: SpaceX gets sensitive US military tracking data — a boost in orbit that raises national-security and industry-control concerns.

stories.title: Uh oh, the iPhone Duo complaints have begun
stories.take: The iPhone Duo honeymoon is over — the first complaints about Apple’s first foldable have begun.

stories.title: Why do AI platforms want humans to design their branding?
stories.take: AI platforms still want humans to design their branding — a telling admission about what taste and identity still require.

stories.title: Just Eat's AI apocalypse raises a glaring question
stories.take: Just Eat’s AI apocalypse raises a glaring question for brands: if AI makes the ad, who owns the idea — and the blame?

stories.title: How Ben & Jerry's became a beacon of brand bravery
stories.take: Ben & Jerry’s became a beacon of brand bravery by putting values in the product, not just the campaign.

stories.title: The Atlanta Falcons 'Nazi' logo controversy strikes again
stories.take: The Falcons logo controversy strikes again — an old design argument brands thought was settled is back in the feed.

stories.title: "Nobody has it figured out, and that’s the point": Radim Malinic on the power of creative risk
stories.take: "Nobody has it figured out, and that’s the point" — Radim Malinic makes the case for creative risk over a safe formula.

stories.title: Jokic rips booing fans after rallying Nuggets: 'They're not welcome anymore'
stories.take: Jokić ripped the boo birds after a 35-point triple-double — his 199th — rallied Denver from 23 down to beat the Pelicans.

stories.title: Embiid posts triple-double as LeBron-less Sixers stay unbeaten
stories.take: Embiid posted a triple-double and Brown scored 27 as the LeBron-less 76ers stayed unbeaten, beating the Bucks 127-116.

stories.title: Giannis fouls out vs. undermanned Hornets as Heat tumble to 0-3
stories.take: Giannis scored just 14 and fouled out as the Heat fell 115-110 to the undermanned Hornets and tumbled to 0-3.

stories.title: Pistons lose $200M man Duren for at least two weeks with hamstring strain
stories.take: Detroit loses its $200M man — Jalen Duren is out at least two weeks with a right hamstring strain, weeks after his five-year extension.

stories.title: Jaylen Brown refuses to let this Jayson Tatum 'lamb chop' die, and it could end up getting seriously juicy
stories.take: Brown says there is no beef with Tatum, just a ‘lamb chop’ — and he refuses to let the former-teammate storyline die.

stories.title: Paolo Banchero is hurt again, and this Magic experiment might be cursed
stories.take: Banchero is hurt again — reportedly out 4 to 6 weeks with a high ankle sprain, and the Magic experiment looks cursed.

stories.title: Brewers 'chip away' at Rays again, rally to take 2-0 lead in World Series
stories.take: Milwaukee did it again — down 4-0 in the first, the Brewers rallied to beat the Rays 5-4 and take a 2-0 World Series lead.

stories.title: How Sal Frelick became Brewers' unlikely World Series hero with Game 2 blast: 'He has this edge about him'
stories.take: Sal Frelick is the unlikely hero — his tying sixth-inning homer delivered the swing of his life in Milwaukee’s Game 2 comeback.

stories.title: Four things that need to happen for Rays to overcome 2-0 World Series deficit vs. Brewers
stories.take: Tampa’s path back starts with Game 3 — four things must happen for the Rays to climb out of a 2-0 hole against Milwaukee.

stories.title: Brewers' Misiorowski unleashes 103.5 mph pitch to set World Series record
stories.take: 103.5 mph on his first pitch — Jacob Misiorowski set the World Series velocity record to open the Fall Classic.

stories.title: Young superstar face-off: What Jackson Chourio and Junior Caminero bring to this World Series
stories.take: Chourio vs. Caminero is the young-superstar face-off defining this World Series — two bright paths to stardom, head to head.

stories.title: Manfred: Small-market World Series good for game, but cap still needed
stories.take: Manfred says a Rays-Brewers World Series is good for the game — but still argues small markets need a salary cap to compete regularly.

stories.title: Blanche defends DOJ lawsuit blocking Alaska Senate results if Republican loses
stories.take: Blanche defended the DOJ suit over Alaska’s Senate race on CNN, saying Trump is not trying to overturn state results “in any way, shape or form.”

stories.title: Obama, in Midwest, assails 'cruelty' and indecency from Trump and his allies in the midterm campaign
stories.take: Obama took his star power to the Midwest, assailing ‘cruelty’ and indecency from Trump and his allies in the final days of the midterms.

stories.title: California election officials frustrated, rattled by DOJ demand to sequester 'noncitizen' ballots
stories.take: California officials are frustrated and rattled by the DOJ demand to sequester ‘noncitizen’ ballots — a problem the administration’s own probes show is rare.

stories.title: Venezuela's opposition leader María Corina Machado returns after months in exile
stories.take: Machado is back in Venezuela after months in exile, announcing “I am here. With you” in her first appearance since Maduro was deposed.

stories.title: Brazil votes in a tense Lula vs. Bolsonaro runoff with U.S. influence over Latin America at stake
stories.take: Brazil votes in a tense runoff — Lula against Flávio Bolsonaro, a Trump ally and son of the imprisoned former president, with US influence in Latin America at stake.

stories.title: New York's archdiocese and survivors of clergy abuse agree to $800 million legal settlement
stories.take: New York’s archdiocese and clergy-abuse survivors agreed to an $800 million settlement, confirmed by Archbishop Ronald Hicks.

stories.take: Iranians fear a return to all-out war as US and Israeli elections approach — Netanyahu says Iran’s leadership must be eliminated and Trump vows to “finish the job.”

stories.take: Last-minute California voter guide: all 14 propositions, covering taxes, voting, healthcare, housing and the environment.

stories.take: Exceptionally high tides are set to swamp California this weekend, with significant coastal flooding expected and officials scrambling to prepare.

stories.title: More storms a-brewin': Could L.A. see its first rainy Halloween in over a decade?
stories.take: LA could get its first rainy Halloween since 2014 — a late-week shift brings a high chance of rain for trick-or-treat night.

stories.title: Why are so many bonds on the California ballot? Here’s what $44 billion would buy
stories.take: California voters will decide $44 billion in bonds — Propositions 1, 37 and 38 would borrow for housing and medical research.

stories.title: AOC, Newsom and Jeffries swing through California to help Democrats in tight races
stories.take: AOC, Newsom and Jeffries are swinging through California in tight House races — a sign the state could decide control of the House on Nov. 3.

stories.title: LA chemical plant on short leash from state regulators as neighbors continue to protest its operations
stories.take: An LA hazardous-waste plant stays on a short leash — regulators agreed with neighbors’ appeal over Phibro-Tech’s violation history but won’t revoke its permit.

stories.title: DoJ voter fraud claims, More high tides coming, Haunted walks -- Sunday Edition
stories.take: DOJ sued California alleging over 20,000 people on voter rolls may not be citizens; AG Rob Bonta is fighting it, counties got a 48-hour deadline, and research shows non-citizen voting is extremely rare • A federal appeals court ruled Trump’s California National Guard deployment to LA during last year’s immigration protests was illegal • Newport Beach declared its second emergency this month; high tides peak Monday–Wednesday up to eight feet, with 100,000 cubic yards of sand approved • Halloween Houdini auction at the Magic Castle: 100 items, including a pocket watch valued at $20,000–$40,000
